segments.name: LNG infrastructure
segments.description: Owns and operates floating regasification terminals and sells regasified natural gas, LNG, power and steam to state owned energy companies, transmission operators and industrial users.
segments.evidence: The Company's contracts with customers may contain one or several performance obligations consisting of terminal services and LNG, gas, and power sales.

revenueModel.text: Customers including state owned energy companies, transmission operators and industrial users pay long-term take-or-pay rates for regasification services and for natural gas, LNG, power and steam.
revenueModel.evidence: We typically enter into long-term take-or-pay contracts with our customers for the use of our LNG infrastructure assets and the services needed to operate them.
